data.body: Corrected review candidate: e6cc07a366bfd9904b4aa2aab4661758685ec0d1 (Change-Id I63a406c865a1b1fe5ab3517e6c352e59300cae5c). The initial independent findings were addressed: the S3 prefix is described as generated versus operator-supplied, and issue-count comparison is limited to the dual-project fetch and preview scenarios that assert it. Certified-basis normalized AST/directive checks pass; the edited prose is 656 to 200 words; seven scenarios collect; lint/typecheck, trailer validation, diff integrity, and worktree hygiene pass. Per operator direction, full make verify is deferred to Gerrit CI. This exact SHA requires a different reviewer and a fresh three-row receipt.
